definitions.basis: Gross cash-payment records only, not loans, noncash support, payables, cancellations or refunds. Earlier or later spending is outside the window.
definitions.payeeGroups: Conservative source-record fingerprints. Same-name groups are a separate descriptive view, not automatic legal-entity merges.
definitions.aggregate: Generic small-expenditure disclosure categories are not supplier identities and never bridge campaigns.
definitions.purposes: One exclusive bucket per cash-payment record based on the reported purpose code. Blank and multi-code records stay separate. A filed code does not establish the underlying economic role.
definitions.relationship: A common payee does not establish candidate coordination, consultant advice, shared political beliefs, an endorsement or beneficial ownership.
definitions.profit: Cash received by a reported payee is not profit; payroll, reimbursement, processor and pass-through payments may be included.
